Show connected neck, shoulder, spine, ribcage, pelvis, four owned limbs, credible floor support and coherent occlusion. No long tail, shag, high white socks, black saddle, giant eyes or puppy head. Buddy has a full moderately elongated continuous charcoal close-coated torso, deep chest, visible neck and genuine leg clearance on substantial legs. Modest projecting muzzle, cream moustache/beard, light curved brows, tan chest fields flanking dark throat, pale lower legs/feet, softly pendant ears. No floor-length body shag, square generic terrier, dachshund-short legs or oversized head. Human appearances if visible are provisional story design, no claimed likeness. Actual selected original photographs govern only visible anatomy; generated model supplies provisional pen/wash style, never anatomy authority. Uncalibrated photos establish no fixed proportions/relative scale, weight, ancestry, motion timing, psychology or exact palette. N35 excludes anatomy; B08 styling only and not used; B25 unavailable; B30 supplemental resting evidence only and not used. Multiple encodings of one exposure count once. Draw clear contour/support construction and complete room staging for inspection.
